Aphelios.build: Build armor to match Aphelios’s main damage. If healing is making the duel drag on, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build.
Aphelios.combo: Start stacking with Kalista Q Pierce, then hop with Kalista P Martial Poise with each basic attack to stay in range. If Aphelios backs away, pull out the stacks with Kalista E Rend before he gets out of range.
Aphelios.escape: When Aphelios is holding Gravitum, watch out for Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites rooting you after the slow, and engage after that tool has been used. While Aphelios is without Severum, he has a hard time escaping, so if you and your Oathsworn agree, close the distance with Kalista R Fate’s Call.
Aphelios.fight: Trade when Aphelios is holding a weapon with low burst damage. Use Kalista P Martial Poise to adjust your distance with each basic attack and stack spears. When Aphelios backs away, use Kalista E Rend.
Aphelios.laning: Pressure the lane early with Kalista E Rend, but don’t stand forward while the enemy support’s engage is available. If marked by Calibrum, immediately back away to preserve your health. Look for a chance to pierce a low-health front minion with Kalista Q Pierce and leave a spear on Aphelios.
Aphelios.phase: Pressure the lane early with Kalista E Rend, but hold your position so you don’t die to an engage. Mid game, as your attack speed items come together, is Kalista’s strong period; start fights based on Aphelios’s weapons. In the late game, immobilizes and strong slows can leave Kalista helpless, so avoid reckless engages from the front.
Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit several of you, and deal sustained damage from behind the frontline with Kalista P Martial Poise. Stack spears on one target and use Kalista E Rend when they back away. If your allied support is in danger, rescue them with Kalista R Fate’s Call.
Aphelios.watch: When a basic attack with Aphelios’s Gravitum slows you, get out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil hits each struck champion with an additional attack, so spread out from your allies when he can cast it.

Ashe.combo: Leave a spear stack with Kalista Q Pierce, then basic attack and hop with Kalista P Martial Poise. If Ashe backs away, hop forward to stay in range and pull out the spears with Kalista E Rend before she gets completely out of range. If you reset its cooldown by killing a speared minion with E, you can pull out the stacks on Ashe again.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no self-peel movement ability, so approach after Ashe W Volley is used. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, avoid a situation where you have to take the arrow before going in. Close the distance with Kalista R Fate’s Call when you and your Oathsworn have agreed on the timing. Enter range only after the enemy support’s crowd control is also used.
Ashe.fight: The moment Ashe W Volley is used is your chance to trade. Use Kalista P Martial Poise to hop with each basic attack, keep your distance, and stack spears. When Ashe backs away, pull them out with Kalista E Rend. While Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus is active, create distance, then move back in after it wears off.
Ashe.laning: Change position with Kalista P Martial Poise while attacking minions, and dodge Ashe W Volley to the side. If Kalista Q Pierce kills a minion in front and passes through it, you can leave spear stacks on Ashe too. Don’t stand forward relying on your hops while the enemy support’s crowd control is available.
Ashe.phase: Pressure the lane early with Kalista E Rend, while watching out for Ashe’s slow and the enemy support’s engage. Mid game, as your attack speed items come together, is Kalista’s peak; make use of your basic attacks and hops to fight then. In the late game, strong slows or immobilizes can leave Kalista helpless, so choose your engages carefully.
Ashe.teamfight: Keep basic attacking from just behind the frontline, hopping with Kalista P Martial Poise. When you get a chance to reach Ashe, focus your spears on one target. When Ashe backs away, pull out the stacks with Kalista E Rend. If the enemy closes in, hop back. Use Kalista R Fate’s Call for an engage agreed on with your Oathsworn or to rescue your allied support.
Ashe.watch: Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow is refreshed with every basic attack, so don’t stay within Ashe’s basic attack range for long. Dodge Ashe W Volley to the side, and don’t start a skirmish from out of vision while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available. When dodging the arrow, change direction instead of running in a straight line.

Caitlyn.build: Because the root from Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap interrupts Kalista’s basic attacks and hops, consider Quicksilver Sash before defensive items. Then build armor against the physical damage from Caitlyn P Headshot and Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Caitlyn.combo: Follow Caitlyn with Kalista P Martial Poise on each basic attack, then use Kalista E Rend when she backs away.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid paths with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap. If you and your Oathsworn are in sync, use Kalista R Fate’s Call to engage during this opening.
Caitlyn.fight: Stack spears with Kalista Q Pierce and basic attacks, using Kalista P Martial Poise’s hops to stay in range. When Caitlyn backs away, pull out the stacks with Kalista E Rend before she gets out of range.
Caitlyn.laning: While Caitlyn is strong early, don’t take risks and give up a kill; collect CS even under your turret. Kalista P Martial Poise needs a target to hit before you can hop, so combine basic attacks and repositioning near minions. Avoid paths covered by Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, and use allied minions to block Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker’s poke.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in the early laning phase, so collect CS safely and don’t give up a kill. Caitlyn’s relative strength declines over time, and Kalista becomes strong in mid game as her attack speed items come together. Even late game, roots and strong slows weaken Kalista’s hops, so choose your approach route carefully.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Keep basic attacking from just behind the frontline with Kalista P Martial Poise, and use Kalista E Rend to pull out the spears stacked on one target when they back away. Avoid chokepoints with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, and hop backward if a threat closes in. Coordinate with your Oathsworn to use Kalista R Fate’s Call to engage or rescue them if they’re in danger.
Caitlyn.watch: If you’re caught by Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, the root interrupts Kalista P Martial Poise’s hop, leaving you exposed to the increased range and empowered attack of Caitlyn P Headshot. Watch for traps in brush and narrow paths, and change your approach route. Stand behind allied minions so they take the hit from Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker first.

Draven.build: Draven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Keep enough health to get out of Draven R Whirling Death’s execute range, and consider lowering his attack speed to reduce his basic attack damage.
Draven.combo: When Draven has one axe or fewer, leave stacks with Kalista Q Pierce and keep basic attacking. Use Kalista P Martial Poise with each attack to adjust your distance. When Draven goes to catch an axe or backs away, slow him with Kalista E Rend and pull out the stacks.
Draven.escape: Engage the moment Draven E Stand Aside has been used. Draven has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you and your Oathsworn agree on the situation, you can close the distance with Kalista R Fate’s Call.
Draven.fight: Don’t fight while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes; look for the moment when he has one or fewer. Aim Kalista Q Pierce at where an axe will land, then slow him with Kalista E Rend to make it harder for him to catch the axe.
Draven.laning: Early on, farm safely instead of trading with Draven while he has two axes. When Draven pushes the lane and steps forward, make room for your jungler to come in. Enter range with Kalista P Martial Poise only after the enemy’s engage tool has been used.
Draven.phase: Early on, focus on avoiding Draven’s two axes and not giving up a kill. Mid game, as your attack speed items come together, is Kalista’s strong period; fight when Draven drops an axe. In the late game, strong slows and immobilizes can leave Kalista helpless, so don’t push too far forward.
Draven.teamfight: From just behind the frontline, stack spears on one target with Kalista P Martial Poise, then use Kalista E Rend when they back away. Disrupt where Draven is going to catch an axe with Kalista E Rend. Coordinate with your Oathsworn to use Kalista R Fate’s Call to engage, or use it to rescue an ally in danger.
Draven.watch: Avoid trading early while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Draven E Stand Aside’s knockback and slow make it harder to maintain distance with Kalista P Martial Poise, so move forward after E has been used. Avoid both the outgoing and returning paths of Draven R Whirling Death so you aren’t executed at low health.

Ezreal.build: Prioritize attack speed items so you can hop more often with Kalista P Martial Poise. If you need defense, account for the physical damage from Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and the magic damage from Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift. If you build only one type of resistance, you’ll still take full damage from the other type.
Ezreal.combo: Leave a spear with Kalista Q Pierce and keep basic attacking. Hop with Kalista P Martial Poise on each attack to stay in range, then use Kalista E Rend if Ezreal backs away. If killing a speared minion with Kalista E Rend resets its cooldown, you can pull out the spears stacked on Ezreal again.
Ezreal.escape: The moment Ezreal E Arcane Shift has been used is your chance to engage. Coordinate the timing with your Oathsworn before closing the distance with Kalista R Fate’s Call. Ezreal has no crowd control, but don’t hop forward while the enemy support’s engage tool is available.
Ezreal.fight: Briefly pressure Ezreal while dodging Ezreal Q Mystic Shot with a minion between you. Make him use Ezreal E Arcane Shift, then move back in and stack basic attacks while keeping in range with Kalista P Martial Poise. When Ezreal backs away, pull out the spears with Kalista E Rend.
Ezreal.laning: Move within the wave so minions block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Kalista P Martial Poise won’t hop unless you basic attack, so don’t stand forward without a target to hit. Enter range after the enemy support’s engage tool has been used.
Ezreal.phase: Early on, Kalista E Rend makes you strong at pressuring the lane, but you can easily get caught by an engage if you stand too far forward. Mid game, as your attack speed items come together, is Kalista’s peak; fight when Ezreal E Arcane Shift has been used. In the late game, immobilizes and strong slows can leave Kalista helpless, so choose your engage timing more carefully.
Ezreal.teamfight: Instead of trading poke with Ezreal from far away, find vision and an angle to close the distance. Keep basic attacking from behind the frontline with Kalista P Martial Poise, and pull out the spears with Kalista E Rend when Ezreal backs away. If your allied support is in danger, rescue them with Kalista R Fate’s Call. When low on health, don’t retreat in a straight line with your allies, so you can dodge Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot with a minion between you. If Ezreal W Essence Flux hits you, his next attack deals extra damage, so briefly get out of range. If Ezreal keeps hitting you with Q, Ezreal E Arcane Shift also comes back sooner.

Jhin.build: Being rooted by Jhin W Deadly Flourish interrupts Kalista P Martial Poise’s hops, so consider Quicksilver Sash before defensive items. Jhin’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor if you build resistance.
Jhin.combo: Build stacks with Kalista Q Pierce, then follow Jhin with basic attacks and Kalista P Martial Poise hops. When Jhin turns and backs away, use Kalista E Rend before the spears disappear or he gets out of range. If the first cast kills a speared minion and resets the cooldown, you can pull out the spears stacked on Jhin again.
Jhin.escape: Jhin reloading or having just fired his final shot is your chance to engage. Check that Jhin W Deadly Flourish and the enemy’s immobilizing tools are down before entering range. If Jhin W Deadly Flourish comes your way, use Kalista P Martial Poise to leave its straight path.
Jhin.fight: Go in while Jhin is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots, and back away when his final shot is ready. Stack spears with Kalista Q Pierce and basic attacks, keeping your distance with Kalista P Martial Poise. When Jhin backs away, pull out the stacks with Kalista E Rend. If Jhin W Deadly Flourish is down and you get a chance to close the distance, you can engage with Kalista R Fate’s Call after agreeing on the timing with your Oathsworn.
Jhin.laning: Stand away from low-health minions so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade doesn’t become stronger after killing one and bounce to you. If you step on a trap from Jhin E Captive Audience, leave its explosion area, and be careful not to get hit by Jhin W Deadly Flourish while standing on it. Kill a speared minion with Kalista E Rend to reset the cooldown and clear the wave.
Jhin.phase: Kalista is strong at pressuring the lane early, so count Jhin’s shots and trade while he reloads. Mid game, as your attack speed items come together, is Kalista’s peak; keep up the pressure with basic attacks and hops. In the late game, Jhin W Deadly Flourish’s root and Jhin E Captive Audience’s slow can shut down your mobility, so choose your engage timing carefully.
Jhin.teamfight: After the frontline has taken Jhin W Deadly Flourish and the traps, stack spears on one target from behind the frontline with Kalista P Martial Poise. If Jhin uses Jhin R Curtain Call, dodge so low-health allies don’t get hit. If someone has to block the shots, have the ally with the highest health percentage do it. Kalista R Fate’s Call can rescue your Oathsworn, so use it when your allies are ready.
Jhin.watch: Jhin P Whisper’s final shot deals heavy damage, so count his remaining shots and back away when it’s the last one. Right after being hit by Jhin’s basic attack or trap, hop to the side with Kalista P Martial Poise to avoid the narrow, straight attack from Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Jhin R Curtain Call gets stronger based on your missing health, so focus on dodging the shots when your health is low.

Jinx.build: Consider Quicksilver Sash before defensive items to counter the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Then build armor against Jinx’s main physical damage.
Jinx.combo: Leave a spear stack with Kalista Q Pierce, then hop with Kalista P Martial Poise on each basic attack to stack more spears. If Jinx backs away, hop forward to stay in range and pull out the stacks with Kalista E Rend before she gets completely out of range.
Jinx.escape: Jinx has no ability to create distance on her own, so go in when Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has already been used. If the slow from Jinx W Zap! also misses, that’s your chance to close the distance with Kalista R Fate’s Call.
Jinx.fight: Look for a chance to fight when Jinx is poking with her rockets and has no minigun attack speed stacks. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! has been used, close the distance with Kalista P Martial Poise and basic attack, then use Kalista E Rend on Jinx as she backs away.
Jinx.laning: When Jinx attacks minions with her rockets, avoid standing right next to them so you don’t also take the area damage. Basic attack and adjust your position with Kalista P Martial Poise, but don’t move forward while the enemy’s crowd control is available.
Jinx.phase: Early on, Kalista E Rend lets you pressure the lane, but be careful not to get caught by standing forward and relying on your hops. Mid game, as your attack speed items come together, is Kalista’s peak; in the late game, roots and strong slows make it hard to fight effectively.
Jinx.teamfight: From just behind the frontline, hop with Kalista P Martial Poise and stack spears on one target. Use Kalista E Rend when they back away. Look for an opening while Jinx E Flame Chompers! and Jinx W Zap! are down, but use Kalista R Fate’s Call to rescue your allied support if they’re in danger.
Jinx.watch: If you’re rooted by Jinx E Flame Chompers!, it interrupts Kalista P Martial Poise’s hops and your basic attacks. Dodge the slow from Jinx W Zap!, and when health has decreased, don’t stay within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.

Kaisa.build: Build armor first against Kai’Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. Kalista hops more often with Kalista P Martial Poise when her attack speed is higher, so build attack speed items afterward. Kai’Sa P Second Skin and Kai’Sa W Void Seeker deal magic damage, so build both magic resistance and health against them.
Kaisa.combo: Leave a spear with Kalista Q Pierce, then keep landing basic attacks. Use Kalista P Martial Poise on each attack to maintain your distance from Kai’Sa, and use Kalista E Rend when she backs away, before she gets out of range. If you can reset the cooldown by killing a speared minion with E, pull out the spears stacked on Kai’Sa as well.
Kaisa.escape: Engage after the enemy support’s crowd control is down. If Kai’Sa W Void Seeker hits you, back away until the mark disappears.
Kaisa.fight: While Kai’Sa R Killer Instinct is down, look for a chance to engage alongside your Oathsworn with Kalista R Fate’s Call. When trading, adjust your distance with Kalista P Martial Poise on each basic attack, and pull out the spears stacked on Kai’Sa with Kalista E Rend when she backs away.
Kaisa.laning: When Kai’Sa looks ready to use Kai’Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand near allied minions to spread out the missiles. Only hop forward to poke after the enemy support’s engage tool has been used.
Kaisa.phase: In mid game, as your attack speed items come together, make use of Kalista P Martial Poise’s hops to fight. In the late game, immobilizes and strong slows can leave Kalista helpless, so don’t go in first; deal sustained damage from a safe position.
Kaisa.teamfight: Stack spears on one target from just behind the frontline, and use Kalista E Rend when they back away. If Kai’Sa engages with Kai’Sa R Killer Instinct, hop back to create distance. If you and your Oathsworn are ready, respond with the forced movement from Kalista R Fate’s Call. If your Oathsworn is in danger, pull them in with R to rescue them.
Kaisa.watch: If you’re hit by Kai’Sa W Void Seeker, you can become a target for Kai’Sa R Killer Instinct. Immediately back toward your allies and don’t give her an angle to engage until the mark disappears. Kai’Sa P Second Skin deals more damage when your health is low, so if stacks have built up, wait out their expiration from outside her range.

KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Armor is also useful against his physical basic attack damage. Since Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals damage based on your maximum health, stacking health alone is inefficient.
KogMaw.combo: Apply the first stack with Kalista Q Pierce, then follow up with basic attacks. Use Kalista P Martial Poise to hop with each attack and maintain your distance from Kog'Maw; when he retreats, use Kalista E Rend to pull the spears. When looking for the bonus damage from Kalista W Sentinel, attack the same target as your Oathsworn support.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility to create distance, so engage when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down. Dodging Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle also reduces the risk of fighting while your resistances are lowered. If the enemy support still has their engage ability, wait until it's down before going in.
KogMaw.fight: Close the gap after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down. Kog'Maw has no way to create distance on his own, so look for a chance to use Kalista R Fate's Call to help your Oathsworn engage. Once you're close, use Kalista P Martial Poise to reposition with each basic attack as you stack spears, then use Kalista E Rend when Kog'Maw retreats.
KogMaw.laning: Early on, use Kalista E Rend to last-hit minions and harass at the same time, disrupting Kog'Maw's farming. Wait out Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, then pressure him near the minions while moving with Kalista P Martial Poise. Don't step forward while the enemy support still has their engage ability.
KogMaw.phase: Early on, disrupt Kog'Maw's farming with lane pressure using Kalista E Rend. Midgame, as you build attack speed items, is a strong period for Kalista, so take objectives and turrets to end the game sooner. Kog'Maw gets stronger as the game goes on, while Kalista is vulnerable to strong slows and immobilizing effects in the late game, so be cautious about engaging in late-game fights.
KogMaw.teamfight: While Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, watch out for its long range and damage based on your maximum health. When an opportunity to engage comes up, target Kog'Maw, who has no mobility, but stay behind the frontline and keep basic attacking with Kalista P Martial Poise; hop backward if an enemy gets close. Stack spears on one target and use Kalista E Rend when they retreat, and use Kalista R Fate's Call to save your support if they're in danger.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, its range is increased and each basic attack deals damage based on your maximum health, so keep your distance until it ends. Block Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle with minions or dodge it to the side, since it reduces armor and magic resistance; if it hits you, don't engage right away. Avoid Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, as its slow makes it harder to manage your distance with Kalista P Martial Poise. Watch for Kog'Maw R Living Artillery when your health is low, and after killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise's explosion.

Lucian.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian R The Culling. The higher Kalista's attack speed, the more often Kalista P Martial Poise lets her hop in the same amount of time, so stack attack speed items to improve your mobility in extended fights.
Lucian.combo: When Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, apply a stack with Kalista Q Pierce and follow up with basic attacks. Use Kalista P Martial Poise with each attack to manage your distance, and pull the stacked spears with Kalista E Rend before Lucian retreats. If you and your Oathsworn are engaging together, you can use Kalista R Fate's Call to get closer to Lucian.
Lucian.escape: The moment after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is used is your chance to close the gap. Confirm the enemy support's engage ability is down too before entering your range, and keep fighting if Lucian's opening combo has ended.
Lucian.fight: Use Kalista P Martial Poise to hop backward and weather Lucian's opening combo. Right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit and his other abilities are down, keep fighting while stacking spears with basic attacks, then use Kalista E Rend when Lucian retreats.
Lucian.laning: Harass with basic attacks near minions while using Kalista P Martial Poise, but don't stand behind minions that Lucian Q Piercing Light can pass through. Don't step forward while the enemy support still has their engage ability or when Lucian's next two shots are empowered. Kill minions with spears stuck in them using Kalista E Rend to reset its cooldown and clear the wave.
Lucian.phase: Early on, you can pressure the lane with Kalista E Rend, but watch out for Lucian's burst and the enemy support's engage. Midgame, as you build attack speed items, is when Kalista hits her stride; hop while dealing sustained damage.
Lucian.teamfight: Stack spears on one target from just behind the frontline with Kalista P Martial Poise, and hop backward if Lucian closes in with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. When Lucian R The Culling starts, sidestep out of its firing angle. Use Kalista E Rend when your target retreats, and save your Oathsworn with Kalista R Fate's Call if they're in danger.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and extends beyond its indicated range, so avoid standing directly behind a minion when he farms. Lucian R The Culling cannot change direction while being cast, so sidestep with Kalista P Martial Poise. When Lucian uses E Relentless Pursuit to engage with his first combo, hop backward to create distance.

MissFortune.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Miss Fortune P Love Tap, Miss Fortune Q Double Up, and Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. Kalista gets stronger as she builds attack speed items in the midgame, so build attack speed items afterward.
MissFortune.combo: Apply a spear stack with Kalista Q Pierce and follow up with basic attacks, using Kalista P Martial Poise to manage your distance with each attack. When Miss Fortune retreats, hop forward to add more basic attacks, then use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacks before she leaves your range. If you've coordinated the engage with your Oathsworn, close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility, so engage after the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is down. If the enemy support still has their non-targeted crowd control, don't hop forward; look for a chance to engage with Kalista R Fate's Call after it's down.
MissFortune.fight: After Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is down, enter range and use Kalista P Martial Poise with each basic attack to manage your distance. If Miss Fortune escapes with Miss Fortune W Strut, damage her with Kalista Q Pierce to slow her movement speed. Attack the same target as your support to aim for the bonus damage from Kalista W Sentinel.
MissFortune.laning: Avoid standing directly behind minions; stand to the side to dodge the bouncing attack from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. After Miss Fortune last-hits a minion, create distance to avoid her empowered basic attack. Use Kalista P Martial Poise hops to pressure her when the enemy support's non-targeted crowd control is down.
MissFortune.phase: Early on, Kalista has strong lane pressure with Kalista E Rend. Midgame, as she builds attack speed items, is her peak, so make the most of her sustained damage then. In the late game, strong slows can leave her powerless, so don't engage through Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.teamfight: When Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is placed, move out of it and fight from an area without the zone. Keep basic attacking with Kalista P Martial Poise from behind the frontline, and use Kalista E Rend to pull the spears stacked on a target when they retreat. Dodge Miss Fortune R Bullet Time to the side; if you've coordinated with your Oathsworn, use Kalista R Fate's Call to interrupt it or save an Oathsworn in danger.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up hits a front target before bouncing behind it, so don't stand in a line with minions. Don't engage while slowed by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, move out to the side of its cone or interrupt the channel with the knockback from Kalista R Fate's Call if you've coordinated with your Oathsworn.

Nilah.build: Build Executioner's Calling to counter the healing from Nilah P Joy Unending, Nilah Q Formless Blade, and Nilah R Apotheosis. Against Nilah's main damage, build armor first, but also build health to account for the penetration on Nilah Q Formless Blade.
Nilah.combo: Use Kalista Q Pierce to leave one spear, then stack more with basic attacks, adjusting your distance with Kalista P Martial Poise after each attack. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, stop stacking with basic attacks. Resume once it ends, then use Kalista E Rend when Nilah backs away.
Nilah.escape: Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so do not go deep just because it has been used once. Your chance to fight comes after Nilah engages and uses Nilah W Jubilant Veil. If you have agreed on it with your Oathsworn, close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call.
Nilah.fight: When Nilah E Slipstream closes the gap, aim Kalista P Martial Poise's hop backward and keep attacking. Once Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, stack spears with basic attacks again, then use Kalista E Rend to retrieve them when Nilah retreats, before she moves out of range.
Nilah.laning: Kalista P Martial Poise's hop will not trigger if there is no target to attack, so harass near minions and avoid standing too far forward. Enter attack range only after the enemy support's engage ability is down.
Nilah.phase: Early on, stop Nilah from scaling with Kalista's lane pressure and harass from outside her range. Mid-game, as attack speed items build up, is Kalista's peak, so fight at a distance where you can keep attacking and hopping. In the late game, letting Nilah engage puts Kalista at risk, so do not stand forward and hop backward as soon as she goes in.
Nilah.teamfight: Use Kalista P Martial Poise to deal sustained damage just behind the frontline, and hop backward if Nilah E Slipstream closes the gap. Keep your distance so Nilah R Apotheosis does not catch several allies; if you are already pulled in, attack Nilah immediately. Coordinate the timing of Kalista R Fate's Call with your Oathsworn, and use it to rescue your support when they are in danger.
Nilah.watch: When Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range briefly increases and her attacks hit a wide area, so take one more step back. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, your basic attacks miss, so stop trading with basic attacks and respond with Kalista Q Pierce or wait for the effect to end. Keep your distance so Nilah R Apotheosis does not pull you in alongside an ally.

Samira.build: Prioritize attack speed items to increase the number of hops from Kalista P Martial Poise. Build armor to resist Samira's main damage.
Samira.combo: After Samira W Blade Whirl ends, start stacking with Kalista Q Pierce. Use Kalista P Martial Poise with each basic attack to manage your distance as you stack more spears. Use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacks before Samira retreats. If Samira closes in, hop backward while continuing to basic attack.
Samira.escape: The moment after Samira E Wild Rush is down is your chance to engage, especially if no one died to the dash. Confirm the enemy support's crowd control is down too, then close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call, coordinating the engage timing with your Oathsworn.
Samira.fight: If Samira has used Samira E Wild Rush and no one died, that's your chance to counterattack. Use Kalista P Martial Poise with each basic attack to maintain your distance as you stack spears, then use Kalista E Rend when Samira retreats. If Samira W Blade Whirl is active, wait until it ends before using Kalista Q Pierce or basic attacks.
Samira.laning: Early on, harass while moving around the minions with Kalista P Martial Poise, but remember that you can't hop without a target to attack. Don't step forward while the enemy support's crowd control and Samira E Wild Rush is ready. Kill minions with spears stuck in them using Kalista E Rend to reset its cooldown and clear the wave.
Samira.phase: Early on, use Kalista's lane pressure and harassment, but don't step forward while Samira still has an engage ability. Midgame, as you build attack speed items, use Kalista's strengths to deal sustained damage with basic attacks and hops. In the late game, immobilizing effects and strong slows can leave Kalista powerless, so avoid engaging and manage your distance.
Samira.teamfight: Move with Kalista P Martial Poise just behind the frontline as you stack spears on one target, then use Kalista E Rend when they retreat. Hop backward if Samira closes in, and look for a chance to interrupt Samira R Inferno Trigger with the knockback from Kalista R Fate's Call. Don't leave low-health allies behind, so Samira can't reset Samira E Wild Rush; you can also use Kalista R Fate's Call to save an Oathsworn in danger.
Samira.watch: Don't use Kalista Q Pierce or basic attacks while Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning; wait for it to end. If the enemy support's crowd control hits you, Samira can close in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge that engage ability first. If Samira gets close and builds her style rank, she can follow up with Samira R Inferno Trigger, so keep your distance.

Senna.build: Consider Quicksilver Sash before a defensive item to counter the root from Senna W Last Embrace. Add Executioner's Calling to your build to counter the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and maintain grievous wounds with basic attacks. Senna's main damage is physical, so build armor for resistance.
Senna.combo: Hit with Kalista Q Pierce, then stack spears with basic attacks, using Kalista P Martial Poise to reposition with each attack. Use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacks when Senna retreats. If you reset its cooldown by killing a speared minion with E, you can use E again to pull the spears stacked on Senna.
Senna.escape: When Senna W Last Embrace is down, look for an opportunity to engage. Senna has no ability to create distance on her own, so coordinate your timing with your Oathsworn and use Kalista R Fate's Call to close the gap. If W hits and marks you, don't engage; move away from your allies.
Senna.fight: Fight within range after Senna W Last Embrace is down. Start stacking with Kalista Q Pierce and hop with Kalista P Martial Poise on each basic attack to maintain your distance. When Senna retreats, hop forward to keep attacking, then use Kalista E Rend to pull the spears before she leaves your range.
Senna.laning: Early on, pressure Senna's low health and watch where her souls fall. Harass her when she steps forward to collect a soul and deny the pickup. Since Kalista P Martial Poise can't trigger a hop without a target to attack, don't step too far forward while Senna W Last Embrace is ready.
Senna.phase: Kalista has strong lane pressure early and Senna has low health, so deny soul collection with harassment. Midgame, as you build attack speed items, is Kalista's strongest period; use basic attacks and hops to deal sustained damage. In the late game, Senna's range and attack damage grow as she collects souls, while roots and strong slows make it hard for Kalista to perform.
Senna.teamfight: Hop with Kalista P Martial Poise just behind the frontline as you stack spears on one target, then use Kalista E Rend when they retreat. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, camouflaged enemies may approach, so fall back to an area with vision. Use Kalista R Fate's Call to engage in sync with your Oathsworn or save a support in danger.
Senna.watch: If Senna W Last Embrace hits you, its delayed root will stop your Kalista P Martial Poise hops and basic attacks. Dodge W from behind minions, and immediately move away from allies if you're marked. Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through its target and travels in a straight line, so avoid the line between Senna and an ally or minion. If Senna hits you once, retreat so she can't get mist from a second attack.

Seraphine.build: Consider Quicksilver Sash before a defensive item to counter the root from Seraphine E Beat Drop. Counter the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound with Executioner's Calling. Build magic resistance rather than armor to resist Seraphine's damage.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, apply a spear stack with Kalista Q Pierce and follow up with basic attacks. Hop with Kalista P Martial Poise on each attack to maintain your range, then use Kalista E Rend when Seraphine retreats. Pull the spears before they disappear or Seraphine leaves your range.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility, so go in right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop. If you're using Kalista R Fate's Call to engage, coordinate the timing with your Oathsworn support first. If you're slowed while Seraphine E Beat Drop is still ready, prioritize moving out of its line over engaging.
Seraphine.fight: The moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your chance to engage. If your support is ready, close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call, then keep attacking and hopping with Kalista P Martial Poise on each basic attack. Use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacked spears when Seraphine retreats.
Seraphine.laning: Trade when Seraphine is alone, away from her allied ranged carry, and Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Reposition near minions with Kalista P Martial Poise, but don't step forward expecting to hop if you have no target to attack. Attack the same target as your support to aim for the bonus damage from Kalista W Sentinel.
Seraphine.phase: Kalista has strong early lane pressure and harassment centered on E, but it's dangerous to step forward while Seraphine E Beat Drop is ready. Midgame, as Kalista builds attack speed items, is her peak, so take advantage when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. In the late game, immobilizing effects and strong slows can leave Kalista powerless, so choose your engage timing more carefully.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to either side so Seraphine R Encore can't extend by hitting allies. Stack spears on one target from just behind the frontline, then use Kalista E Rend when they retreat. You can save an Oathsworn in danger with Kalista R Fate's Call, but don't use it when your support isn't ready.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets, so if you get slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so spread out to either side of your allies.

Sivir.build: Add Executioner's Calling to your build to counter the healing from Sivir E Spell Shield. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet deal physical damage, so build armor first.
Sivir.combo: Draw out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then apply a stack with Kalista Q Pierce. Follow up with basic attacks and use Kalista P Martial Poise to maintain your distance, then use Kalista E Rend before Sivir gets out of range.
Sivir.escape: Avoid a long chase while Sivir R On The Hunt is active; after it ends, close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call.
Sivir.fight: Feint an engage to draw out Sivir E Spell Shield, then fight. Use Kalista P Martial Poise with each basic attack to manage your distance, then use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacked spears when Sivir retreats.
Sivir.laning: Move and basic attack near minions with Kalista P Martial Poise, while dodging the outbound and return paths of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Sivir clears waves quickly, so push the lane in advance or make sure an ally is ready to catch the wave when you leave lane.
Sivir.phase: Early on, Kalista can pressure the lane with Kalista E Rend, but be careful not to step forward and let the enemy engage on you. Midgame, as she builds attack speed items, is her peak, so keep fighting with basic attacks and hops. In the late game, immobilizing effects and strong slows can leave her powerless, so deal damage from just behind the frontline.
Sivir.teamfight: Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you can coordinate with your Oathsworn and engage Sivir with Kalista R Fate's Call. Attack the same target as your support to aim for the bonus damage from Kalista W Sentinel, and hop backward with Kalista P Martial Poise if an enemy closes in. Save your allied support with Kalista R Fate's Call if they're in danger.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit on the way out and back, so dodge the outbound blade and move out of its path on the return. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so don't engage with Kalista Q Pierce or Kalista R Fate's Call before it's down. Avoid a long chase while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.

Smolder.build: Kalista can keep up Grievous Wounds with basic attacks, so buy Executioner's Calling to counter the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!. If you need durability, build armor first, but remember that resistance cannot block the true damage from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath.
Smolder.combo: Use Kalista Q Pierce to leave one stack, then follow up with basic attacks and change your hop direction with Kalista P Martial Poise to stay in range. When Smolder retreats, use Kalista E Rend before he gets completely out of range. If you reset its cooldown by killing a speared minion using Kalista E Rend, you can Rend the spears stacked on Smolder again.
Smolder.escape: The moment Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down is your chance to engage. If the enemy support's crowd control is also down, close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call, but use it when your Oathsworn is ready.
Smolder.fight: Smolder has low armor early, so pressure him early with Kalista's physical damage. Make him use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, then, if the enemy support's engage tool is also down, close the gap with basic attacks and Kalista P Martial Poise. Don't force a chase while slowed by Smolder W Achooo!.
Smolder.laning: Disrupt Smolder's CS from the start to slow the growth of Smolder P Dragon Practice. Use Kalista P Martial Poise to move around minions while harassing, but remember that you can't hop without a target to attack. Don't move forward while the enemy support still has crowd control available.
Smolder.phase: Smolder has low health and armor early, so Kalista can use lane pressure to deny his farm. Kalista is strong in the mid game as attack speed items come together, so take objectives and turrets quickly. Smolder gains the advantage late game because of the permanent stacks from Smolder P Dragon Practice.
Smolder.teamfight: Use Kalista P Martial Poise just behind the frontline to stack spears on one target, then use Kalista E Rend when they retreat. Hop backward if an enemy closes in, and move out of the center of Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!. Use Kalista R Fate's Call to engage when Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down or to rescue an Oathsworn who is in danger.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! explodes when it hits a champion, granting growth stacks and slowing them, so stand behind minions or sidestep with a hop to dodge it. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so move out of the flames, then reengage. Once Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath has enough stacks, its true damage and execute become a threat, so avoid fighting at low health.

Tristana.combo: Stack one spear with Kalista Q Pierce, and use Kalista P Martial Poise to maintain your distance with each basic attack. When Tristana retreats, hop forward to add more basic attacks, then use Kalista E Rend before she gets completely out of range.
Tristana.escape: The moment after Tristana uses Tristana W Rocket Jump is your chance to engage. If Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are both ready, delay your engage; close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call when you have crowd control ready to interrupt Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Tristana.fight: Close the gap and fight right after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down. Use Kalista P Martial Poise to reposition with each basic attack, then use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacked spears when Tristana retreats.
Tristana.laning: Early on, push the lane toward Tristana's turret to make last-hitting difficult for her. Keep your distance from minions so you don't take area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. If the enemy support still has their engage ability, don't step forward relying only on Kalista P Martial Poise hops.
Tristana.phase: Early on, Tristana is weak and her ability cooldowns are long, so Kalista can push the lane and pressure her. Midgame, as Kalista builds attack speed items, is her peak. Aim to end the game before Tristana's full build becomes too difficult to handle.
Tristana.teamfight: Keep basic attacking with Kalista P Martial Poise just behind the frontline, and hop backward if Tristana closes in with Tristana W Rocket Jump. Stack spears on one target and use Kalista E Rend to pull them when the target retreats. If an ally dies and resets Tristana W Rocket Jump, retreat immediately, and use Kalista R Fate's Call to save your Oathsworn if needed.
Tristana.watch: Don't engage recklessly while Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are both ready. When Tristana kills a minion, damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge spreads in an area, so don't stand close to allied minions.

TwistedFate.build: Get attack speed first so Kalista P Martial Poise lets you hop more often over the same amount of time. Magic resist is more effective than armor against Twisted Fate's damage, so build magic resist if you need durability.
TwistedFate.combo: When Twisted Fate's gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is down, use Kalista Q Pierce to apply a spear, then follow up with basic attacks. Hop with Kalista P Martial Poise after each attack to stay in range, then use Kalista E Rend when he retreats.
TwistedFate.escape: Delay your engage if Twisted Fate is holding a gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Once you close the gap, keep your distance with basic attacks and Kalista P Martial Poise.
TwistedFate.fight: Engage just after Twisted Fate uses his gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Stack spears with Kalista Q Pierce and basic attacks, adjusting your range with Kalista P Martial Poise after each attack. Use Kalista E Rend before he retreats out of range.
TwistedFate.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and use Kalista P Martial Poise to reposition when you have a target to attack. Don't move forward while the gold card is ready; harass after he uses it.
TwistedFate.phase: Kalista E Rend makes your lane pressure strong early, so look for a chance to harass when the gold card is down. In the mid game, as attack speed items come together, take advantage of Kalista P Martial Poise's frequent hops to fight. Late game, choose your engage timing more carefully so stuns and heavy slows don't pin you down.
TwistedFate.teamfight: When Twisted Fate uses his gold card, close the gap with Kalista P Martial Poise and focus your damage. Stack spears on one target, then use Kalista E Rend when they retreat.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, it will stun on his next basic attack, so stay out of range. Stand behind minions to reduce the damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.

Twitch.build: Buy a Control Ward first in lane to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals both physical and magic damage, so building only armor or magic resist blocks just part of it. Twitch P Deadly Venom's true damage can't be reduced with resistances, so consider building health and ways to reduce Twitch's attack speed.
Twitch.combo: Use Kalista Q Pierce to leave a spear, then follow up with basic attacks and hop with Kalista P Martial Poise. When Twitch retreats, use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacked spears. If Twitch W Venom Cask lands, hop backward instead of staying to deal more damage.
Twitch.escape: Engage when you're out of the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask and Twitch Q Ambush has ended, revealing his position. Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you can coordinate with your Oathsworn, use Kalista R Fate's Call to close the gap.
Twitch.fight: Fight outside the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask, adjusting your range with Kalista P Martial Poise after each basic attack. If Twitch retreats, hop forward to stack more spears, then use Kalista E Rend before he gets out of range. If Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position, coordinate with your allies to focus him.
Twitch.laning: Use Kalista P Martial Poise to reposition while attacking minions and take advantage of your early lane pressure. If Twitch disappears, watch for Ambush or a roam to another lane and alert your allies. Killing a speared minion using Kalista E Rend resets its cooldown, so use it to secure last hits and clear waves.
Twitch.phase: Kalista's lane pressure and poke with Kalista E Rend are strong early. The mid game, as attack speed items come together, is Kalista's peak, so look for fights where you can keep attacking and hopping. Heavy slows weaken Kalista's mobility late game, so don't stay and fight for long after stepping in Twitch W Venom Cask.
Twitch.teamfight: Spread out sideways from your allies so you don't all get hit by Twitch R Spray and Pray's piercing basic attacks. If Twitch Q Ambush ends or Twitch activates Twitch R Spray and Pray and takes position, coordinate with your allies to focus him. Keep attacking and hopping from behind the frontline, and use Kalista R Fate's Call to rescue an Oathsworn in danger if needed.
Twitch.watch: Twitch can approach with Twitch Q Ambush, so check bushes without vision and narrow paths first. Leave immediately if Twitch W Venom Cask lands under you. If you've been hit by several basic attacks, create distance before Twitch E Contaminate lands, even if you still have plenty of health. When Twitch activates Twitch R Spray and Pray, its range increases and his basic attacks pierce enemies, so don't line up with allies.

Varus.build: If Varus R Chain of Corruption binds you, it interrupts Kalista's basic attack hops, so consider Quicksilver Sash before defensive items. If you build resistances, prioritize armor against the physical damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. Varus W Blighted Quiver deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health pool alone.
Varus.combo: Use Kalista Q Pierce to leave one stack, then follow up with basic attacks, adjusting your range each time with Kalista P Martial Poise. When Varus retreats, use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacks before he gets completely out of range. If you reset its cooldown by killing a speared minion using E, you can Rend the stacks on Varus again.
Varus.escape: Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so after Varus R Chain of Corruption is down is a good window to engage. When he aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep its path and close the gap. If the enemy support still has an engage tool, wait for it to be used before entering range.
Varus.fight: When you see the aiming animation for Varus Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep its path and look for a chance to close the gap. After Varus R Chain of Corruption is down, stack spears while adjusting your range with Kalista P Martial Poise after each basic attack, then use Kalista E Rend when Varus retreats. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can also close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call.
Varus.laning: Kalista has strong lane pressure and poke early, so use Kalista P Martial Poise to hop around minions. If Varus's basic attacks have stacked Blight on you, retreat and resume harassing after the stacks expire. Healing is reduced in areas covered by Varus E Hail of Arrows, so heal outside them.
Varus.phase: Kalista has strong lane pressure and poke early, but standing too far forward because you trust your hops can get you caught easily. The mid game, as attack speed items come together, is Kalista's peak, so make use of your basic attack hops in fights.
Varus.teamfight: Use Kalista P Martial Poise just behind the frontline to stack spears on one target, then use Kalista E Rend when they retreat. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, create distance so the tendrils don't spread to you. Don't engage while Varus is stronger from a kill or assist, and use Kalista R Fate's Call to rescue an Oathsworn in danger.
Varus.watch: If Varus hits you with an ability while stacks from Varus W Blighted Quiver are applied, it triggers damage based on your maximum health. If you've been hit by a few basic attacks, retreat and give the stacks time to expire. Avoid Varus R Chain of Corruption, which interrupts Kalista's basic attack hops. If an ally is bound by the chain, create distance so its tendrils can't reach you.

Vayne.build: Build attack speed items so you can increase the number of hops from Kalista P Martial Poise. If you need resistances, build armor first against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Armor can't reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, though.
Vayne.combo: When Vayne Q Tumble is down, use Kalista Q Pierce to apply a spear, then follow up with basic attacks. Reposition with Kalista P Martial Poise after each attack, and use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacked spears when Vayne retreats. If you reset its cooldown by killing a speared minion using Kalista E Rend, you can Rend the spears stacked on Vayne again.
Vayne.escape: The moment Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble is your chance to engage. If you can coordinate with your Oathsworn, close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call. Approach from away from walls to avoid being stunned by Vayne E Condemn.
Vayne.fight: Fight right after Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble. Stack spears with Kalista Q Pierce and basic attacks, keep your distance with Kalista P Martial Poise, then use Kalista E Rend when Vayne retreats. If Vayne E Condemn is still available, don't chase her near a wall.
Vayne.laning: Vayne has low health and armor early, so push the lane to pressure her farm. Use Kalista P Martial Poise to keep attacking and hopping around minions, but don't force your way forward while the enemy still has an engage tool. Attack the same target as your support to make use of the bonus damage from Kalista W Sentinel.
Vayne.phase: Early on, use Kalista's lane pressure to disrupt the weak early-game Vayne's farming. In the mid game, as attack speed items come together, use Kalista's strengths to take objectives and turrets. Vayne gets harder to deal with as the game goes on, so make use of your early and mid game advantage.
Vayne.teamfight: Avoid narrow paths and fight in open areas, dealing sustained damage from behind the frontline with Kalista P Martial Poise. If Vayne closes in, hop backward while continuing to attack, and use Kalista E Rend to pull the spears stacked on a target when they retreat. Use Kalista R Fate's Call to engage with a ready Oathsworn or rescue an Oathsworn in danger.
Vayne.watch: If Vayne E Condemn knocks you into a wall, you're stunned, so don't fight with your back to a wall. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on maximum health if she keeps attacking the same target, so hop out of range with Kalista P Martial Poise before it triggers.

Xayah.build: If Xayah E Bladecaller roots you, Kalista's basic attacks and hops are interrupted, so consider Quicksilver Sash before defensive items. Xayah's main damage is physical, so build armor for resistance.
Xayah.combo: Use Kalista Q Pierce to leave a spear, then stack more with basic attacks and hop with Kalista P Martial Poise after each attack to avoid Xayah's feather return paths. If Xayah retreats, stay in range and use Kalista E Rend to pull the spears before she gets completely out of range.
Xayah.escape: First check the return paths of the feathers on the ground for Xayah E Bladecaller, then close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call from a safe angle.
Xayah.fight: Don't fight Xayah in the same spot for long. Make short trades, changing position with Kalista P Martial Poise after each basic attack. If the return path of Xayah E Bladecaller is dangerous, sidestep first.
Xayah.laning: Attack minions while moving with Kalista P Martial Poise, and remember that you can't hop without a target to attack. Don't fight for long where Xayah is stacking feathers; keep trades short. Killing a speared minion using Kalista E Rend resets its cooldown and lets you clear the wave.
Xayah.phase: The mid game, as attack speed items come together, is Kalista's peak, so pressure Xayah while Xayah R Featherstorm is down. Late game, roots can shut down Kalista's mobility, so watch the feather positions as you fight.
Xayah.teamfight: Don't rush an engage with Kalista R Fate's Call while Xayah R Featherstorm is available. Deal sustained damage just behind the frontline with basic attacks and Kalista P Martial Poise, and sidestep Xayah E Bladecaller's feather return paths. Look for an engage after Xayah R Featherstorm is down, but you can also use Kalista R Fate's Call to rescue an Oathsworn in danger.
Xayah.watch: If Xayah E Bladecaller hits you with three or more returning feathers, it roots you. When three or more feathers lie along a line connecting you and Xayah, use Kalista P Martial Poise to hop sideways out of that line. Don't rush in while Xayah R Featherstorm is available.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Kalista is strong in the mid-game as attack speed items build up, so get attack speed afterward.
Yasuo.combo: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with a basic attack, then start stacking spears with Kalista Q Pierce once the shield disappears. Adjust your distance with Kalista P Martial Poise after each basic attack as you stack more spears, then use Kalista E Rend when Yasuo backs away. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is active, use Kalista Q Pierce from a position where it can go around the wall, or save it until the wall disappears.
Yasuo.escape: Your chance to go in comes when you dodge Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado or just after it passes. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so do not go deep just because he used it once. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes off cooldown, look for an opening in coordination with your allies' crowd control. If you have agreed on it with your Oathsworn, close the gap with Kalista R Fate's Call.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with a basic attack, then trade in earnest after it disappears. If Yasuo closes in, keep basic attacking while hopping backward with Kalista P Martial Poise; if he backs away, hop forward to stay in range. Use Kalista E Rend to retrieve your stacked spears before Yasuo leaves your range.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin on your side of the lane to reduce the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use to approach. Do not rely on your hops and stand forward while Yasuo's engage is available. Killing a minion marked with a spear using Kalista E Rend resets its cooldown, so use it for last hits and wave clear.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, Kalista E Rend gives you strong lane pressure and harass, but letting Yasuo E Sweeping Blade engage is dangerous. Mid-game, as attack speed items build up, is Kalista's peak, so fight while keeping your distance with basic attacks and hops. You are still vulnerable to immobilizes and strong slows in the late game, so do not go in first.
Yasuo.teamfight: Use Kalista P Martial Poise to attack one target with basic attacks and build spear stacks just behind the frontline. Hop backward immediately if Yasuo closes in, and use Kalista E Rend when the target you have stacked spears on backs away. Coordinate the timing of Kalista R Fate's Call with your Oathsworn, and use it to rescue your support when they are in danger.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the gap, so be careful about hopping forward near minions. Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move sideways as he approaches. After it hits twice and his tornado is ready, watch for the knock-up. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, save Kalista Q Pierce and go around the wall or wait for it to disappear.

Zeri.build: Build armor first against Zeri's main damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Armor can't block the magic damage from Zeri P Living Battery and Zeri E Spark Surge, and building a large health pool alone also increases the maximum health-based damage from Zeri P Living Battery.
Zeri.combo: Use Kalista Q Pierce to leave one stack, then land a basic attack and hop with Kalista P Martial Poise to stay in range. Use Kalista E Rend to pull the stacked spears before Zeri retreats out of range. If you reset its cooldown by killing a speared minion using that ability, you can Rend the spears stacked on Zeri again.
Zeri.escape: The moment Zeri E Spark Surge is down is your chance to engage. If you and your allied support are ready, use Kalista R Fate's Call to close the gap during this window. Don't move forward while the enemy support still has an engage tool; wait for it to be used.
Zeri.fight: Once Zeri has used Zeri E Spark Surge, close the gap and fight in open terrain. Keep your range with Kalista P Martial Poise after each basic attack as you stack spears, then use Kalista E Rend when Zeri retreats. Don't chase on foot after Zeri activates Zeri R Lightning Crash.
Zeri.laning: Build a lead with Kalista's early pressure before Zeri gets her core items. Attack minions while repositioning with Kalista P Martial Poise, but remember you can't hop without a target to attack. Don't move forward while the enemy support still has an engage tool.
Zeri.phase: Early on, use Kalista's lane pressure to build a lead before Zeri gets her core items. The mid game, as attack speed items come together, is Kalista's peak, so take advantage of windows when Zeri E Spark Surge is down. Late game, Zeri's mobility makes her harder to catch, and strong slows or immobilizing effects also make it difficult for Kalista to perform.
Zeri.teamfight: Use Kalista P Martial Poise just behind the frontline to stack spears on one target, then use Kalista E Rend when they retreat. If an enemy closes in, hop backward while continuing to attack. Don't force a chase while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, and use Kalista R Fate's Call to rescue your allied support if they're in danger.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely when it hits terrain, so don't stand with your back to a wall or face her in a narrow path. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing a wall, so don't push her toward one. After Zeri activates Zeri R Lightning Crash, she speeds up as she hits targets, so don't force a chase.

Ziggs.build: Kalista P Martial Poise lets you hop more often over the same amount of time when your attack speed is higher, so prioritize attack speed items. If you build resistances against Ziggs's damage, choose magic resist over armor.
Ziggs.combo: If you kill a low-health front minion with Kalista Q Pierce and it passes through, you can leave a spear stack on Ziggs behind it. Follow up with basic attacks while pursuing with Kalista P Martial Poise, then use Kalista E Rend to pull the stack before Ziggs gets completely out of range.
Ziggs.escape: Engage when Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and there is a path not blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. If your Oathsworn is ready and timed with you, use Kalista R Fate's Call to close the gap during this window.
Ziggs.fight: Close the gap right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. Stack spears with Kalista Q Pierce and basic attacks, keep your range with Kalista P Martial Poise after each attack, then use Kalista E Rend when Ziggs retreats.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, attack minions while moving with Kalista P Martial Poise and look for last hits and poke with Kalista E Rend. Avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and move forward after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave.
Ziggs.phase: Early on, Kalista can pressure the lane with Kalista E Rend, but she can die easily if she overextends, so fight after Ziggs's tools for disrupting your engage are down. The mid game, as attack speed items come together, is Kalista's peak; late game, watch especially for the slow from Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield.
Ziggs.teamfight: Deal sustained damage just behind the frontline with basic attacks and Kalista P Martial Poise, and avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, look for an engage, but also use Kalista R Fate's Call to rescue an Oathsworn in danger.
Ziggs.watch: Stepping on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you and makes it easier to get hit by his other abilities, so take a path without mines or wait until they disappear. When the range of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, use Kalista P Martial Poise to hop away from the center if you can hop by attacking a target; otherwise, walk out.
